method: Read-only IDA pseudocode/disassembly, ordinary source review and static JSON/AST/lexical/byte comparison only. No project code, generator, compiler, test suite, benchmark or CI execution.

Member latent gating checks bind, awoken-bind, dungeon flags+33 bits4/0x20, and latent 48 requires effective awakening 60 via table 0x100f1548c.

Live main/sub overrides and current parameter primary/secondary/tertiary attributes. Main override propagates to existing fallback sub/third.
Two dynamic awakening grant rows at impl+744732, stride12, six awakening IDs at row+4. L/ L+ rows are unknown until predicates are implemented.

Recovery accumulator adds effective L count for latent48 providers during generated L-attack entries; equal secondary/tertiary colors skip duplicate credit. Native remaining duration is reduced after queue pass. Current diagnostic deliberately does not claim final per-board recovery amount or ordering.
Enemy action case0x8D sets temporary assist invalidation; no enemy selector/RNG/action function is called by diagnostics.
Active assist may disappear for temporary form, dungeon prohibition, temporary invalidation except awakening148, consumed assist state, or badges. Source assist remains separately observable.
